title: Manageable care leaves hope room

captions.physics: Combining different needs through available help
captions.emotions: Feeling openness to a good possibility

meaning: Your care can support hope when warm conditions and a manageable balance of needs leave room for a still uncertain wish.
text: Hope can remain free when a place is found for it. In the physical position of Anahata, Temperance expresses care through actions combining different needs without eliminating either. The Empress in energy brings a wish to create warm conditions and support growth. The Star in emotions offers openness to a good possibility without guaranteeing a result. Tenderness may come from an uncertain idea not requiring the whole of shared life to be rearranged. Support allows trying while preserving both people’s comfort.

For example, one person wants to start growing a few herbs while the other needs balcony space for relaxing. Together you choose a narrow box that leaves the needed place free. **A manageable measure can give hope space without a large promise.** The first seeds need not immediately become a beautiful garden. Warmth stays in an accepted wish and different needs considered rather than proving a trial repays every concession and will interest both equally.

A generous intention can quietly turn a small trial into a large shared project. A discovered measure disappears, while hope demands continuing through tiredness. Alternatively, one person silently yields all space to preserve calm. Care keeps an actual answer and permission to reduce the amount. Growth can be supported without prescribing one outcome or making each new pot a test of willingness to love someone else’s interest.
